serviceRendererExceptions.docker: Container status is attached through service server/container settings and discovery, not a generic integration connection.
serviceRendererExceptions.kubernetes: Pod status is attached through service namespace/app settings and discovery; cluster Home widgets remain in the Home library.

proxyOnlyExceptions.ical: Internal calendar feed proxy alias; add an iCal event source inside Calendar, not a standalone service widget.
proxyOnlyExceptions.unifi_console: Home UniFi Controller proxy alias; the service renderer is unifi.

personalHomeExceptions.weatherapi: Requires a shared provider credential; personal configuration cannot add credentials or provider-backed Home widgets.
personalHomeExceptions.glances: Requires a remote connection and credentials.
personalHomeExceptions.unifi_console: Requires a controller connection and credentials.

standaloneComponentExceptions.proxmoxvm: VM status is rendered directly by the service item through its Proxmox binding, not the integration renderer registry.
